property_summary: For any valid call to fallback (10 ether, timestamp > pastBlockTime), the contract’s ETH balance after the call must be zero if and only if block.number % 15 == 0; after the fallback executes, the invariant holds for the original contract, but the mutant always transfers the balance, causing a non-zero balance when block.number % 15 != 0.
change_summary: Replace 'if(block.number % 15 == 0)' with 'if(true)' so the transfer always occurs, changing the balance returned to sender and internal state (balance) surfaced via ETH transfers.
